name: Curve Fever Pro
description:
About This Game

Curve Fever

Curve Fever is a fast-paced online multiplayer arena game where every turn matters.
Take control of a constantly moving ship, leave a deadly trail behind you, and battle against up to 9 other players in chaotic rounds of survival, strategy, and skill.

The rules are simple: don’t crash. Avoid walls, dodge enemy trails, squeeze through tiny gaps, and carve out safe paths before the arena becomes a maze of curves. But survival alone is not always enough. Equip powers, attack your opponents, steal their points, and protect your own lead before someone turns the match against you.

Every round is a mix of sharp reflexes, clever positioning, and perfectly timed attacks. Play defensively and outlast everyone, or go on the offensive and hunt the players with the biggest score. The more points your target has, the more rewarding your attack can be.

Enter the arena, meet your opponents, and let the battle begin.

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Easy to learn, Hard to master

You only need a few buttons to play: steer left, steer right, and activate your equipped powers. But mastering Curve Fever is all about control. Learn to tap your turns, read the arena ahead, create space, escape traps, and use your powers at exactly the right moment.

Powers change every match

Equip powers before each match and create your own playstyle. Choose defensive powers to survive longer, offensive powers to steal points, or tricky utility powers that disrupt the arena.

Powers include projectiles, lasers, bombs, mines, fevers, shields, jumps, dashes, teleports, and more. With 30 unique powers and many possible combinations, every match can play differently.

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Play ranked or Create your own rooms

Jump into Quick Play for ranked FFA matches against players close to your skill level, or create custom rooms and invite your friends.

Custom rooms let you change the way the game plays with different game modes, team setups, map sizes, scoring rules, power settings, pickups, turrets, modifiers, spectators, room privacy, and more.

Game modes:

  • Classic FFA - Everyone fights for themselves. Survive to earn points and use your powers to steal points from opponents. First to reach the target score wins.

  • Classic Teams - Team up with other players and fight as a group. Your team’s score is shared, so every survival play and every successful attack helps push your team closer to victory.

  • Survival Teams - A pure survival-focused team mode. Outlive the enemy team to score. Offensive stealing is removed, making positioning, camping, teamwork, and survival skills even more important.

  • 1v1 - A duel mode based on Classic FFA rules, but with only one opponent. Prove who has the better control, timing, and power usage.

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Pickups and Custom Chaos

In custom matches, pickups can spawn on the battlefield and apply effects to you, your opponents, or everyone in the match. Speed up, slow down, become tiny, grow huge, reverse controls, create holes, shrink the arena, reset cooldowns, and more.

Progression and Rewards

Play matches, gain XP, unlock powers, complete challenges, climb the ranked leagues, and collect rewards.

Customize your profile and ship with skins, avatars, hats, and emotes.
Earn cosmetics through treasures, battle passes, tournaments, events, challenges, and the reward shop.

Social Features

Chat with players globally, privately, or during matches. Add friends, join their games, invite others to your rooms, inspect profiles, view stats, check match history, and share your best moments.

Replays and Highlights

Watch previous matches with replay controls, round selection, playback speed, player follow, zoom, and frame stepping. Clip your best moments into highlights and share them with the community.

Competitive Community

Take part in ranked play, climb the leaderboards, compete for Grandmaster status, join community tournaments, submit weekly clips, and earn rewards through events and challenges.

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

What to expect

We're actively working on improving Curve Fever so you can expect:

  • Regular patches and updates based on suggestions by the community

  • Periodic balance updates

  • Monthly Official Tournaments hosted by community helpers
